LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 7: My body (Functions of the body) Strand Sub Strand Specific Lear
Topic 2.9: Reading aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading aloud, part of READING Theme 7: My body (Functions of the body) Strand Sub Strand Specific Lear in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: where the peer has placed an object (wo ist mein Kuli? Dein Kuli ist in dem Pult ...). Why should you read with a good tempo?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read aloud names of things in the classroom (z.B der Bleistift, die Tafel...),

2. read short simple texts on location of things in the classroom,

3. read aloud in turns

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read aloud names of things in the classroom (z.B der Bleistift, die Tafel...),
2. read short simple texts on location of things in the classroom,
3. read aloud in turns

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: Learner develops confidence when they read texts aloud and clearly and effectively on location of things in the

classroom.

37

Values:
Integrity : Learner ensures that classroom items are in their rightful places for order in the classroom.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Problem solving: Learner is sensitised on the importance of keeping their classroom organized when they read texts on

location of classroom items.

Link to other Learning Areas

Learner links the concept of prepositions of place to the same concept in English and Kiswahili.
